$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.description: Runtime mode. production arms the production readiness boot gate and hides /readyz details.

vars.name: TRUST_PROXY
vars.description: Number of reverse-proxy hops whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for the client IP. Unset or 0: the socket address is used.

vars.name: FONDERIE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
vars.description: How background work runs: auto awaits on serverless and detaches elsewhere.

vars.name: FONDERIE_BACKGROUND_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: Upper bound on awaited background work per request (default 5000).

vars.name: FRONTEND_URL
vars.description: Browser frontend origin, for CORS. Unset: cross-origin browser calls fail the preflight.

vars.name: PORT
vars.description: Port for a long-running server. Ignored on serverless.

vars.name: VERCEL
vars.description: Set by Vercel; its presence marks a serverless runtime. Never set it yourself.

vars.name: AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME
vars.description: Set by AWS Lambda; its presence marks a serverless runtime. Never set it yourself.

vars.name: FUNCTION_TARGET
vars.description: Set by Google Cloud Functions; its presence marks a serverless runtime. Never set it yourself.

vars.name: K_SERVICE
vars.description: Set by Cloud Run / Knative; its presence marks a serverless runtime. Never set it yourself.

vars.name: FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME
vars.description: Set by Azure Functions; its presence marks a serverless runtime. Never set it yourself.
